before: if (~g_en | latch_state | OTP | latch_assert | UVLO) begin
mutants.description: In S_HICCUP latch_assert only blocks the retry instead of forcing S_OFF, as if a strike-latched converter just stayed in the cool-down
mutants.reason: strike_counter raises latch_assert on entry to S_HICCUP when MAX_STRIKES is reached; the original FSM goes to S_OFF the next clock, while the mutant stays in S_HICCUP with hiccup_active high and state_out = S_HICCUP indefinitely (latch_assert is set-only).

before: if (~g_en | latch_state | OTP | latch_assert | UVLO) begin
mutants.description: Over-temperature during S_HICCUP is treated as part of the cool-down: the FSM stays in S_HICCUP until OTP clears instead of going to S_OFF
mutants.reason: With OTP asserted while in S_HICCUP, the original moves to S_OFF on the next clock; the mutant keeps hiccup_active high and state_out at S_HICCUP, then retries into S_SS once OTP falls and hiccup_done is high, without ever passing through S_OFF.

mutants.description: The host enable over SPI is treated as a start request checked only in S_OFF, so a host disable while ramping, running or in hiccup is ignored
mutants.reason: If spi_enable falls while the FSM is in S_SS or S_RUN with en_SW high, the original drops en at once and goes to S_OFF; the mutant keeps en high and stays in its state until the physical switch or a fault turns it off.

mutants.description: run_active is raised on the clock the ramp reports SS_done, a clock before the FSM has registered S_RUN
mutants.reason: In S_SS with SS_done high (and no fault), run_active goes high one clock before state_out shows S_RUN. It also pulses high when SS_done and window_trip_SS arrive together and the FSM goes to S_HICCUP instead.

mutants.description: ss_active is raised on the clock the cool-down reports hiccup_done, a clock before the FSM has registered the retry into S_SS
mutants.reason: In S_HICCUP with hiccup_done high, ss_active is high together with hiccup_active one clock before state_out shows S_SS. It also pulses when a hard fault arrives on that clock and sends the FSM to S_OFF instead.

mutants.description: hiccup_active is held until the cool-down timer drops hiccup_done, as if leaving S_HICCUP had to wait for the timer's acknowledge
mutants.reason: After the retry from S_HICCUP to S_SS, hiccup_active stays high while hiccup_done is still high, so it overlaps ss_active in S_SS. In the system this keeps hiccup_timer from ever clearing hiccup_done, so hiccup_active stays high through S_SS and S_RUN.
